title: Run a typed decision-plane Agentic Recipe with batched questions
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He soft-binds questions/state/facts on the `decision_plane` Agentic Recipe, runs it via `run_recipe`, and verifies the typed batch path yields a code-owned final action. [^rc-decision-plane]
implementation: Agentic Recipe `decision_plane` via `DecisionPlaneTemplate` runners and product verb `run_recipe` (`DecisionPlaneRecipeAdapter`).
